title: Arithmetic Sequence Calculator
description: From the first term and common difference get the nth term and the sum of the first n terms.
howto: Enter the first term a₁ and common difference d.
Enter which term number n you want.
Press Calculate for the nth term and the partial sum.

faqs.a: Each term adds the same constant d: a₁, a₁+d, a₁+2d, …

faqs.q: How does the sum formula work?
faqs.a: Pair the first and last terms: each pair sums to the same value, and there are n/2 pairs — Sₙ = n/2 · (first + last).
Yes, the sequence then decreases — the formulas are unchanged.
